description.html: Quartz sand in a 1kg pack is a quality decorative sand for aquariums that gives the bottom a clean, bright and natural look. The fine grain lets plants root easily, while the neutral color nicely highlights the colors of fish and aquatic plants. Quartz sand is chemically inert - it does not affect pH or water hardness, which makes it safe for all types of freshwater aquariums.

Before use, always rinse the sand several times under running water until the water runs clear, to remove dust that can cloud the aquarium. It is also suitable as a decorative element in dry terrariums for desert species, although in that case make sure the animals do not swallow sand while catching food.
